source.title: Final Fantasy Tactics PlayStation instruction manual (Square, mirrored scan)

verifiedPrinciples: A unit can move once and act once in an active turn.
Speed influences how quickly its CT fills and how often it acts.
Skipping movement or action preserves some CT.
The player chooses facing at the end of the turn.
Altitude and terrain affect combat; Move, Jump and Speed appear in status.
prototypeScope: One movement and one action, in either order, with final facing selection.
Enemy actions ordered by speed within the scripted enemy phase.
Facing affects physical damage; waiting protects the front.
Character panel reads live battle values, inventory and implemented abilities.
notImplemented: Full CT simulation and independent unit turns
Job progression, JP and ability inheritance
